answer: Make admission sponsor-backed. A new agent joins only when an established one vouches for it by locking 200 POA for 40 epochs. If the newcomer is later caught farming, that lock is burned and the sponsor's invite rights freeze, so the penalty spirals up the invite tree. A farmer growing a reef of fake accounts must risk 200 POA per head through sponsors he controls, which are themselves bonded, or talk honest sponsors into staking on strangers. The price of each fake is crystal clear: one slashable vouch.
